# THE PULL-REQUEST FORMS OF THE NIGHTLY GATES (docs/CI-TIERS.md).
#
# A gate whose only workflow runs on a schedule or on dispatch checks nothing a
# pull request changes until the night after it lands: the strict Ruby gate
# ran only nightly, and a RuboCop offense reached main (2026-11-22). Each row
# here is the fast form of one such gate. ci-fast.yml runs it, as a row of its
# nightly-fast job, on any push or pull request that touches the row leg, or a
# path its paths pattern matches, or the broad rule; a diff to this file runs
# every row. Each row fits the two-minute job cap: its nightly job time on the
# fleet is in docs/CI-TIERS.md.
#
# Fields, separated by " | ":
#   name   the matrix row
#   leg    the toolchain the job sets up, and the plan leg that selects the row
#          ("-" for none)
#   paths  an extended regular expression; a changed path it matches selects
#          the row
#   run    the shell line the row runs, from the repository root, with the
#          pinned siblings at ../serialize* (the job clones them)
#
# internal/nightlyrows parses this file and picks the rows; internal/ci
# TestEveryNightlyOnlyGateHasAPRTierForm holds every nightly-only workflow to a
# row here or to a named ci-fast job, and every make target named here to a
# definition.

# the per-language hostile-input corpora (schema-<lang>-runs-hostile-corpus.yml)
hostile-c | c | (^|/)schema[-_]c[-_]runs[-_]hostile|^internal/ci/hostilecorpus/ | make schema-c-runs-hostile-corpus SERIALIZE_C=../serialize.c
hostile-cpp | cpp | (^|/)schema[-_]cpp[-_]runs[-_]hostile|^internal/ci/hostilecorpus/ | make schema-cpp-runs-hostile-corpus SERIALIZE=../serialize
hostile-cs | cs | (^|/)schema[-_]cs[-_]runs[-_]hostile|^internal/ci/hostilecorpus/ | make schema-cs-runs-hostile-corpus SERIALIZE_CS=../serialize.cs
hostile-dart | dart | (^|/)schema[-_]dart[-_]runs[-_]hostile|^internal/ci/hostilecorpus/ | make schema-dart-runs-hostile-corpus DART=dart
hostile-elixir | elixir | (^|/)schema[-_]elixir[-_]runs[-_]hostile|^internal/ci/hostilecorpus/ | make schema-elixir-runs-hostile-corpus ELIXIR=elixir ELIXIRC=elixirc
hostile-java | java | (^|/)schema[-_]java[-_]runs[-_]hostile|^internal/ci/hostilecorpus/ | make schema-java-runs-hostile-corpus JAVA=java JAVAC=javac
hostile-js | js | (^|/)schema[-_]js[-_]runs[-_]hostile|^internal/ci/hostilecorpus/ | make schema-js-runs-hostile-corpus NODE=node
hostile-lua | lua | (^|/)schema[-_]lua[-_]runs[-_]hostile|^internal/ci/hostilecorpus/ | make schema-lua-runs-hostile-corpus schema-lua-runs-hostile-corpus-planted
hostile-luau | luau | (^|/)schema[-_]luau[-_]runs[-_]hostile|^internal/ci/hostilecorpus/ | make schema-luau-runs-hostile-corpus
hostile-moo | moo | (^|/)schema[-_]moo[-_]runs[-_]hostile|^internal/ci/hostilecorpus/ | make schema-moo-runs-hostile-corpus
hostile-python | python | (^|/)schema[-_]python[-_]runs[-_]hostile|^internal/ci/hostilecorpus/ | make schema-python-runs-hostile-corpus schema-python-runs-hostile-corpus-negative-control
hostile-ruby | ruby | (^|/)schema[-_]ruby[-_]runs[-_]hostile|^internal/ci/hostilecorpus/ | make schema-ruby-runs-hostile-corpus
hostile-rust | rust | (^|/)schema[-_]rust[-_]runs[-_]hostile|^internal/ci/hostilecorpus/ | make schema-rust-runs-hostile-corpus RUSTUP_BIN="$(dirname "$(command -v cargo)")" RUST_HOSTILE_PROFILES=debug RUST_HOSTILE_JOBS="$(getconf _NPROCESSORS_ONLN)"
hostile-squirrel | squirrel | (^|/)schema[-_]squirrel[-_]runs[-_]hostile|^internal/ci/hostilecorpus/ | make dist-squirrel schema-squirrel-runs-hostile-corpus
hostile-unity | unity | (^|/)schema[-_]unity[-_]runs[-_]hostile|^internal/ci/hostilecorpus/ | make schema-unity-runs-hostile-corpus SERIALIZE_CS=../serialize.cs

# the resource bounds (schema-<lang>-resource-bounds.yml)
bounds-lua | lua | (^|/)schema[-_]lua[-_]resource[-_]bounds | make schema-lua-resource-bounds schema-lua-resource-bounds-negative-control
bounds-luau | luau | (^|/)schema[-_]luau[-_]resource[-_]bounds | make schema-luau-resource-bounds schema-luau-resource-bounds-negative-control
bounds-python | python | (^|/)schema[-_]python[-_]resource[-_]bounds | make schema-python-resource-bounds
bounds-ruby | ruby | (^|/)schema[-_]ruby[-_]resource[-_]bounds | make schema-ruby-resource-bounds
bounds-squirrel | squirrel | (^|/)schema[-_]squirrel[-_]resource[-_]bounds | make dist-squirrel schema-squirrel-resource-bounds-fast

# the generated-code strict gates not already in lang-lint
strict-ruby | ruby | (^|/)schema[-_]ruby[-_]generated[-_]strict|^internal/codegen/ruby/rubyrun/|^internal/codegen/ruby/rubocop\.yml$ | make schema-ruby-generated-strict-gate-fast
strict-luau | luau | (^|/)schema[-_]luau[-_]generated[-_]analyze | make schema-luau-generated-analyze-strict-gate schema-luau-generated-analyze-strict-gate-negative-control
strict-moo | moo | (^|/)schema[-_]moo[-_]generated[-_]analyze | make schema-moo-generated-analyze-strict-gate schema-moo-generated-analyze-strict-gate-negative-control
strict-dart-all | dart | (^|/)schema[-_]dart[-_]generated[-_]strict | make schema-dart-generated-strict-analyze-gate-all DART=dart
strict-lobster | lobster | (^|/)schema[-_]lobster[-_]generated[-_]strict | make tables-lobster-clean schema-lobster-generated-strict-gate-negative-control

# the saved fuzz vectors the nightly campaigns found, replayed
replay-dart | dart | (^|/)schema[-_]dart[-_]nightly[-_]fuzz | make schema-dart-nightly-fuzz-replay DART=dart
replay-lua | lua | (^|/)schema[-_]lua[-_]nightly[-_]fuzz|^testdata/lua-nightly-fuzz/ | make schema-lua-fuzz-replay
replay-luau | luau | (^|/)schema[-_]luau[-_]nightly[-_]fuzz|^testdata/luau-nightly-fuzz/ | make luau-nightly-fuzz-replay

# the differentials and the fixed-form proof
differential-squirrel | squirrel | (^|/)schema[-_]squirrel[-_]all[-_]port[-_]differential | make dist-squirrel schema-squirrel-all-port-differential-fast
lobster-fixed-proof | lobster | (^|/)lobster[-_]fixed[-_]proof | make -j4 lobster-fixed-proof-fast
